carried_evidence.note: Paraphrase concept units and one application case unit carried from the CWE-011 export against the quality-unverified Instinct derivative record, embedded in sources.json for traceability. They are not gate-counted and no quotation is included: the export retains no source text and 0 of its 249 quote candidates are verified. Three export concept units were not carried: ev-td-jakes-instinct-c001 (Author Background and Authority) is biography, not a decision concept; ev-td-jakes-instinct-c010 (Author Voice and Language) is not carried because the seat must never imitate the person; ev-td-jakes-instinct-c011 (Direct Quotes) is not carried because no quotation is verified in this build and quotations are gated.

covered_note: Gate-counted coverage follows the CWE-012 validator: only evidence bound to a primary_substantive source record counts toward the Section 8.2 minimum. This pack has no primary_substantive record, so gate-counted coverage is honestly 0 concepts and 0 application cases, even though paraphrase concept units are carried for traceability (see carried_evidence). Claiming the carried units as gate coverage would be coverage inflation and is not done.
